articles.title: Kargil War veteran attacked with iron rod in Gurgaon over parking row, suffers serious head injuries
articles.summary: A Kargil War veteran was severely attacked with an iron rod in Gurgaon following a parking dispute, sustaining serious head injuries. This incident, involving a decorated serviceman, underscores the critical importance of maintaining law and order, ensuring civilian safety, and demonstrating appropriate respect for those who have served the nation, even amidst everyday civic disagreements. Authorities are actively investigating the assault.
